descriptionHtml:
**Rapoo H120 Black USB Headset**


**Brand:** Rapoo

**Model:** H120

**Type:** Wired USB Headset

**Color:** Black

**Connection:** USB (wired)


**Audio Specifications:**

Driver Unit: 40mm dynamic driver

Frequency Response: 20Hz - 20kHz

Impedance: 32Ω ± 15%

Sensitivity: 115dB ± 3dB


**Microphone Specifications:**

Type: Omnidirectional microphone (built-in)

Microphone Sensitivity: -38dB ± 3dB

Frequency Response: 100Hz - 10kHz

Noise Cancellation: Yes (basic)


**Controls:**

In-line Remote Control: Yes

Volume Control: Rotary dial (on cable)

Microphone Mute: Yes (switch on cable)

LED Indicator: Yes (mute status)


**Cable:**

Cable Length: 1.8 - 2.0 meters (6 - 6.5 feet)

Cable Type: Braided or rubber (depending on version)

USB Connector: USB-A


**Compatibility:**

PC (Windows 7/8/10/11)

Mac (macOS)

Linux

Laptops with USB-A port

PS4 / PS5 (may work partially)

USB-A devices only (not USB-C without adapter)


**Physical Specifications:**

Headband Type: Adjustable (self-adjusting)

Ear Cushions: Soft foam / leatherette

Ear Cup Design: On-ear (not over-ear)

Weight: 120 - 150 grams (lightweight)

Foldable: Yes (for portability)


**Features:**

Plug and Play (no driver required)

USB powered (no batteries needed)

Noise-isolating ear cushions

In-line volume control

Microphone mute switch

LED mute indicator

Lightweight design


**Package Includes:**

Rapoo H120 USB Headset

User manual


**Warranty:** 1 year 


**Pros:**

Affordable price

USB connection (digital audio, no sound card needed)

Plug and Play

Lightweight and comfortable

In-line volume control

Mute switch with LED indicator

Foldable for travel


**Ideal For:**

Office work (VoIP calls, Zoom, Teams, Skype)

Online classes

Call centers

Casual music listening

Gaming (basic, not competitive)

Home office use


**Not Ideal For:**

Professional audio production

Competitive gaming (no surround sound)

Noisy environments (on-ear design)

High-end music listening
